items.title: Dead AFL star's mother accuses league of 'cover up' on brain injury
items.description: West Coast Eagles star Adam Hunter's mother Joanne Brown says AFL executive Laura Kane reached out to her, but the grieving mother says the phone call was "too little, too late".

items.title: Flooding rain and gales ahead for southern Australia this weekend
items.description: A powerful winter cold front will cause a broad band of rain and strong winds to sweep across southern Australia during the coming days.

items.title: How the Iran war spread beyond one single strait
items.description: The Middle East conflict isn't just widening, it's highlighting more vulnerabilities in the region.

items.title: Albanese returns to a gambling debate ready to catch fire
items.description: The explosive evidence heard at a two-day inquiry into Labor's proposed crackdown on wagering advertising has proved a watershed moment for the increasingly friendless bill.

items.title: Inside the first week of Alan Jones's trial
items.description: Alan Jones sat impassively, legs crossed, with a notebook and pen in hand as the first of six male complainants began testifying this week in his indecent assault trial.

items.title: Global economic policy seems to be at the mercy of Bessent's to-do list
items.description: Global economic policy now seems at the mercy of an exceptionally casual approach to information, scribbled on a notepad, awaiting an update on Scott Bessent's to-do list.

items.title: 'Once-in-a-lifetime' discovery found in a cave hidden beneath a paddock
items.description: There are very few places on Earth that remain untouched and unseen by humans. For true explorers, the final frontier is not a distant speck in the sky, it is the underground realm beneath our feet.

items.title: How to avoid the singles tax without finding a romantic partner
items.description: The singles tax has nothing to do with the ATO, it's the extra people pay when they can't split costs like rent, internet, insurance and other household bills the way couples can.

items.title: Unknown Australian soldiers identified decades after deaths in action
items.description: The soldiers died on the same day, 24 years apart. The first fell in Europe towards the end of World War I and the second in the Pacific Theatre during World War II.

items.title: 'It's infuriating': The trapped and vulnerable feeling when you're hacked
items.description: ABC business reporter David Taylor was hacked on X and warns how easily it could happen to you.

items.title: Cory Doctorow thinks Australia should be worried about digital sovereignty
items.description: Cory Doctorow says the AI revolution promised by tech bros isn't inevitable but the bursting of an AI bubble is. He wants to remind us another future is possible.

items.title: Fourteen-year-old killed grandparents before deadly school rampage, Thai police say
items.description: At least seven people, including teachers and students, have died after a student opened fire at a school in Thailand.

items.title: US unexpectedly sheds 23,000 jobs in blow for Trump before midterms
items.description: Donald Trump has unleashed a spate of policies aimed at reviving domestic manufacturing and curbing surging inflation but new figures show job growth has been declining since March.

items.title: ACCC launches food labelling inquiry after Four Corners investigation
items.description: Australia's consumer watchdog has launched an inquiry into allegations of misleading consumer conduct after a major Four Corners investigation examining food fraud.

items.title: Tragic figure or traitor? New show looks at life of Bennelong
items.description: Bennelong sang the first Aboriginal song on English soil in 1793. His life and legacy is under the microscope in Jane Harrison's play Bennelong in London.

items.title: ABC 50/50 quiz: Test your knowledge of Bowie albums, royal birthdays and pigs vs sheep
items.description: Each question in the ABC 50/50 quiz has only two options: one is right, the other is wrong. You have an even chance of fluking a correct guess.

items.title: The unexpected day jobs of Australia's female footballers
items.description: The dual lives that female athletes have to balance to play at an elite level and have a career is often forgotten.

items.title: A 'gasp' and he was gone. Coroner warns of Federation Peak dangers
items.description: A Victorian bushwalker who wanted to climb Federation Peak in Tasmania's south-west as part of his "bucket list" had turned back with his companions when he fell, a coroner says.

items.title: Lawyers for Andrew and Tristan Tate urge US judge to release them from jail
items.description: The brothers' lawyers argued their "extraordinary public visibility" would make it impractical for them to try to flee and there was no need to keep them behind bars until proceedings end.

items.title: 'Doesn't look great': Fears Penrith captain could miss rest of NRL season
items.description: Penrith captain Isaah Yeo may miss the rest of the NRL season after injuring his pectoral muscle, while the Sydney Roosters joined the Panthers on top of the table after defeating the Canterbury Bulldogs.

items.title: Ruthless Lions send ominous warning to AFL rivals by dismantling Hawks
items.description: Brisbane shows the rest of the competition why it has won the last two premierships by dominating Hawthorn at the Gabba.

items.title: Travis Head pips star duo to win second-straight Allan Border Medal
items.description: Swashbuckling batter Travis Head's big year — including three Ashes centuries — wins him a second straight Allan Border Medal, with fellow Ashes heroes Alex Carey and Mitchell Starc hot on his heels.

items.title: Artwork riffing on Renaissance painting and George Orwell wins $100k
items.description: Ryan Presley has won the top prize at the National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Art Awards for an oil painting riffing on Renaissance art.

items.title: Victoria announces poultry lockdown as bird flu cases spread
items.description: Testing confirmed a further 20 cases of H5N1avian influenza in Victoria on Friday, all in greater crested terns along the state's south-west coast.

items.title: Men to be offered prostate screening from age 45 under new guidelines
items.description: New guidelines released today will change the way men are screened for prostate cancer and lead to less invasive testing.
